opportunities.title: Coldcard's $150M Problem: When 'Not Your Keys, Not Your Coins' Meets a Supply-Chain Exploit
opportunities.why_now: Galaxy's new estimate pegs Coldcard-related losses near $150M, turning a niche hardware-wallet issue into a self-custody credibility crisis.
opportunities.angle: Security teardown: what actually broke (device, firmware, or human), and why 'cold storage' isn't a synonym for 'safe' — end with a checklist of what self-custody actually requires now.

opportunities.title: The French Tax Leak Just Doxxed 678,000 Bitcoin Holders to Every Wrench-Attack Crew in Europe
opportunities.why_now: A government breach exposing tax data on crypto holders lands right as wrench attacks are already piling up — this is the exact failure mode the self-custody crowd never prices in.
opportunities.angle: Threat-model piece: state-held KYC/tax data as the real attack surface, not exchanges — practical opsec for people whose government already knows what they hold.

opportunities.title: Tether's 'First Audit' Isn't an Audit — It's a Press Release With KPMG's Logo On It
opportunities.why_now: Tether just claimed its first full KPMG audit while declining to publish the actual statements, and the CEO's 'I don't care' response is a gift for a skeptical breakdown.
opportunities.angle: Explainer/takedown: audit vs. attestation vs. 'trust me,' with a plain-English list of what's still not disclosed — voice-perfect for 'people who already know how this ends.'

opportunities.title: Neutrl Just Froze Redemptions — Here's the Reserve-Impact Story Nobody Wants to Say Out Loud
opportunities.why_now: A synthetic-dollar protocol pausing mint/redeem while 'assessing reserve impact' is the exact pre-depeg language market veterans have learned to read as a red flag.
opportunities.angle: Live incident tracker: timeline of the pause, what 'assessing reserve impact' usually precedes, and a framework for spotting the next one before it freezes your funds.

opportunities.title: $116M in Self-Custody Losses This Month Alone — Bitcoin's 'Not Your Keys' Mantra Has a Body Count Now
opportunities.why_now: Cointelegraph's roundup puts a hard number on the self-custody incident wave, giving the beat a clean data point to anchor a broader security thesis.
opportunities.angle: Data-led op-ed: aggregate the incident numbers (Coldcard, wrench attacks, France leak) into one 'self-custody tax' figure and argue why the market is underpricing operational security risk.
